text:
sam.k: FinCorp purchase stalled on Azure Marketplace. PO attachment rejected: attachment_hash_mismatch.
rachel.s: customer uses AdobeSign zipped envelope. They refuse single PDFs.
dexter.ops: log shows "422 Unprocessable Entity: attachment_hash_mismatch". Any recent unzip changes?
lana.eng: we rolled libzip tweak 2026-03-05 that normalizes filenames; signed envelopes can break.
anil.legal: altering signed bytes is risky for regulated finance customers. We need opt-in raw ingestion + audit.
marketplace-bot: created ticket MP-5901 "az-marketplace-zip-preserve" assigned to @lana.eng.
lan a.eng: estimate: 1 engineer, 1.5 days to add preserve_raw flag + zip-safety scanner. Ops needs quota checks.
dexter.ops: ops can enable canary route once legal signoff obtained.
rachel.s: I'll request customer ACK now and update here.
